svg.aria-label: GitHub Actions: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs on every push and PR to main. Jobs: Lint & type check (ESLint + tsc --noEmit), unit tests with coverage + Next.js build, Storybook build + visual regression, E2E against the production build. Same checks locally: pnpm run lint && pnpm run type-check && pnpm test && pnpm run test:e2e
